admission_invariants: Original debit and account floor remain bound; every historical and terminated primary charge carries exactly once under the combined 25 USD ceiling. A complete accepted primary final receipt and original absence reconciliation are mandatory before H.

The full original primary receiver runs from verified source bytes in an isolated process before watcher arming. Exact prerequisite hashes and a file/directory identity inventory bracket the full rehash and are rechecked immediately before creation; both creation locks and the unchanged watcher freshness guard remain.

Every prior H lease must satisfy absence reconciliation, finite elapsed-time/rate charge lower bounds, exact combined/prior arithmetic and a complete nonoverlapping predecessor chain. Parsed state and pin derive from the same bytes; final record and full ledger membership checks detect concurrent mutation. Each prior H charge reduces the same aggregate 6 USD allowance.
The maximum new H envelope is 29760 seconds at the unchanged hard rate, plus 0.15 USD margin: 5.989890410958905 USD. Account, remaining phase and combined funds independently restrict admission.

The receiver uses up to eight 64 MiB range readers, fixed retrieval/watch deadlines, exact owned worker/SSH identity, descriptor/path guards, immutable resumable chunk records, full SHA validation and atomic durable publication. The original source snapshots, external semantic validation, accepted-stage reuse, receipt binding and independent emergency shutdown remain. Worker STOP permits preservation; range cancellation quiesces owned processes and descendants.
integration_conditions: Actual complete primary final acceptance and verified reconciled shutdown remain required before any H debit/admission.
A separately accepted scientific implementation and frozen bundle must preserve original N100 estimator, native evidence, seal chain and historical readout definitions.
Actual measured native-gate timing must admit all 100 calibration prompts and readouts before the fixed work deadline; the preservation and termination reserves stay separate.

The prior reverse eight-stream probe measured 3545351.5540594817 bytes/s. Local fixtures verify transport mechanics, not future provider throughput or successful transfer of the eventual full-size H artifacts.
